title: Customer Care Administrator
description:
SF Partners are working exclusively with a multi award winning robotics company based in Birmingham who are upscaling their operations and looking for a Customer Care Administrator.
£28,000 - £35,000
Office based

About the Role

We are looking for a passionate and customer-focused Customer Care Executive to join our growing team. Working within a premium luxury brand, you will be responsible for delivering an exceptional customer experience across multiple communication channels, ensuring every interaction reflects the high standards of our brand.

You will manage customer enquiries from initial contact through to resolution, providing a professional, empathetic and proactive service. This role would suit someone who enjoys problem-solving, thrives in a fast-paced environment and genuinely enjoys helping customers.

Experience supporting customers in the US market and within a luxury or premium product environment is highly desirable.

Key Responsibilities
Respond promptly and professionally to customer emails, ensuring all enquiries are handled within agreed service levels.
Deliver exceptional customer service across email, telephone and live chat where required.
Monitor and respond to social media comments and customer messages, maintaining a positive brand reputation.
Resolve customer complaints and queries efficiently, taking ownership through to completion.
Manage customer claims relating to damaged, faulty or missing products.
Liaise with warehouse, logistics and courier partners to investigate delivery issues.
Process replacements, refunds and exchanges in line with company policy.
Build strong relationships with customers through clear, friendly and professional communication.
Keep accurate records of all customer interactions using CRM systems.
Escalate complex issues where appropriate whilst maintaining ownership of the customer experience.
Identify recurring customer issues and provide feedback to help improve products, processes and service.
Work closely with the wider operations, logistics and marketing teams to ensure a seamless customer journey.
Support peak trading periods and promotional campaigns when required.
Skills & Experience

We are looking for someone who has:

Previous experience within a Customer Care, Customer Service or Customer Experience role.
Experience working within a luxury, premium or high-end consumer products environment.
Previous experience supporting US customers or working within an international customer service environment.
Excellent written communication skills with exceptional attention to detail.
Strong problem-solving and conflict resolution skills.
Experience responding to customers via email and social media platforms.
Ability to remain calm and professional when handling complaints.
Highly organised with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
Strong IT skills with experience using CRM or customer service platforms.
A proactive approach and a genuine passion for delivering outstanding customer experiences.

title: HR Assistant
description:
HR Coordinator Birmingham City Centre - Fully Office Based up to 35 K - plus free parking Full Time, Permanent

Gleeson Recruitment Group is delighted to be partnering exclusively with a leading international organisation to recruit an HR Coordinator to join its growing UK HR team in Birmingham. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced HR Administrator, HR Assistant or HR Coordinator looking to develop their career within a dynamic, international environment. Working closely with the UK HR Business Partner and a central HR function overseas, you will play a key role in delivering a high-quality, commercially focused HR service across the UK.

The Role

As a key member of the UK HR team, you will provide support across the full employee lifecycle, acting as a trusted point of contact for managers and employees while ensuring HR processes remain compliant, accurate and efficient.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Acting as a key HR contact for managers and employees across the UK, working closely with the HR Business Partner and wider HR team.
- Supporting payroll and HR administration, including contracts, employee changes and monthly payroll coordination.
- Maintaining accurate employee records, HR systems, digital personnel files and reporting.
- Coordinating end-to-end recruitment activity, including job postings, applicant tracking, interview coordination and onboarding.
- Supporting employee lifecycle processes including onboarding, probation, absence management and offboarding.
- Providing day-to-day advice and support to managers and employees on HR-related queries.
- Supporting HR compliance, audits, policy updates and continuous improvement initiatives.
- Contributing to both UK and global HR projects, including areas such as employee retention, wellbeing and employer branding.
- Ensuring confidential and sensitive employee information is managed appropriately and in line with relevant legislation and company standards.

About You

We are looking for an HR professional who is proactive, organised and confident working across a broad range of HR activities.

You will ideally have:
- Previous experience in an HR Assistant, HR Administrator or HR Coordinator position, ideally within an international or multi-site organisation.
- A good working knowledge of UK employment law, HR processes and payroll.
- Practical experience across recruitment, onboarding and wider employee lifecycle processes.
- A relevant degree in Business Administration, Psychology, HR or a related discipline would be advantageous.
- CIPD qualification, or working towards one, would be desirable.
- Excellent organisational and multitasking skills, with a proactive and detail-focused approach.
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the confidence to work with stakeholders at all levels.
- Strong IT skills, particularly Microsoft Office and experience using HRIS platforms such as Workday.
- The ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with a high level of professionalism and discretion.
- A collaborative, hands-on approach and the ability to work independently when required.

Why This Opportunity?

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a successful international business and become an integral part of its UK HR function. You will have exposure to a broad range of HR activity, work alongside experienced HR professionals and contribute to both local and international HR projects.

To apply for the position, please click on the apply now button and your CV will be sent directly to the responsible recruiter. We will respond to successful applicants within 7 days, however please feel free to get in touch if you would like any further information about your application.

At Gleeson Recruitment Group, we embrace inclusivity and welcome applicants of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities. We are proud to be a disability confident employer.
By applying you will be registered as a candidate with Gleeson Recruitment Limited. Our Privacy Policy is available on our website and explains how we will use your data.

We are recruiting a Administrator role for a small, friendly and growing block management company based in the Five Ways area of Birmingham, They are looking for a confident and organised individual to join their close-knit team.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys being busy, likes variety in their day and wants to work somewhere where everyone knows everyone and your contribution genuinely matters.

The company manages a portfolio of residential properties and prides itself on providing a personal, professional service to its clients and residents. They re a sociable, supportive team who work hard but also know how to have fun along the way.

About the Job
- Office Administrator
- Five Ways, Birmingham
- Up to £28 K
- 9.00am-5.00pm Monday to Friday

What You'll Get
- Up to £28 K
- 25 days annual leave + Bank Holidays + 3-4 extra days for Christmas shutdown
- Company pension scheme

Role and Responsibilities
- Ensure the follow up existing leads and stimulate new opportunities through effective calling techniques
- Generate appointments with existing contacts within the company database and discover new, extended contacts to target for visits

title: Customer Service Administrator

title: Work From Home Market Research Panelist - Part Time Administration Assistant Welcome
description:
Apex Focus Group collaborates with research firms, universities, and trusted brands to gather genuine consumer insights.

We help connect everyday people with flexible work from home part time market research opportunities that influence real products, services, and customer experiences.

Role Overview

We are welcoming participants from all backgrounds, including anyone looking for administration assistant or admin roles, to take part in upcoming market research studies. These may involve online discussions, product testing, or feedback sessions - typically conducted remotely online.

This is a casual, project-based opportunity ideal for anyone interested in taking part in research on a part time basis, depending on their availability and profile fit.

Requirements
- Access to a smartphone, tablet, or computer with a functional camera
- Reliable internet connection
- Ability to read instructions carefully and provide honest, detailed feedback
- An active email address to receive study invitations and participation details

Benefits
- Take part only in studies that match your interests and schedule
- Research types include online or in-person focus groups, virtual interviews, product testing, and other feedback activities
- No previous administration assistant or admin experience needed. Just a willingness to share your opinions
- Some studies may include early access to new products or services before launch
- Many studies offer compensation, which varies by study type and duration

Compensation:
- Amount varies based on the selected focus group or research assignment.

If you'd like to contribute to research that influences real-world products and decisions, or simply looking for flexible part time, work from home roles, we invite you to submit your interest online today.

Use the 'Apply' button to apply for this position now.

Important Notice - No Fees Required

Participation is always free. We never request or accept any fees for registration or study involvement. Please stay cautious and only respond to communications sent directly from us.

title: Part-time Business Support Officer
company: Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Your new company
Due to the partnership between Hays and Birmingham City Council, we are looking to recruit a part-time Business Support Officer to support their SENAR team. Being the largest leading local authority in the whole of Europe, Birmingham City Council are renowned for their expertise in public services and endless opportunities. Birmingham City Council provides the city's residents with a number of services to ensure stability within citizens' daily lives.Your new role
Birmingham City Council is looking for a highly organised and motivated Business Support Officer to join our SENAR (Special Educational Needs Assessment and Review) Central Business Support Team on a part-time basis (21 hours per week).
This is an excellent opportunity to play a vital role in supporting children and young people with special educational needs and disabilities across Birmingham. Working within a busy and supportive team, you will provide high-quality administrative support to help ensure Education, Health and Care Plan (EHCP) processes are delivered accurately and within statutory timescales.
As a Business Support Officer within the SENAR Central Business Support Team, you will provide essential administrative support to ensure the smooth delivery of Education, Health and Care Plan (EHCP) processes for children and young people across Birmingham. The role involves managing a busy shared mailbox, maintaining accurate records, processing documentation, and responding to enquiries from families, schools, colleagues and external professionals. Working in a fast-paced environment, you will help the team meet statutory deadlines, deliver excellent customer service, and ensure administrative processes are completed efficiently and accurately.
What you'll need to succeed
We are looking for a highly organised and detail-oriented individual with excellent administrative and customer service skills. You will be confident managing a busy and varied workload, able to prioritise competing demands, and comfortable communicating with a wide range of stakeholders including families, schools, colleagues and external professionals. A positive, flexible approach, strong IT skills, and the ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team are essential. Most importantly, you will be committed to providing a high-quality support service that helps improve outcomes for children and young people with special educational needs and disabilities.
What you'll get in return
You will be paid a competitive hourly rate and have a guaranteed long-term, full-time role, with further opportunities for permanent opportunities. As a Hays contractor, you will have a dedicated consultant who will support you throughout the recruitment process as well as whilst you are at work. You will be given access to our training platform, where you can assign yourself to free online training to enhance your own skills.
What you need to do now
If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now.
If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career.

title: Customer Support Advisor
description:
At AX, we're passionate about keeping drivers on the road and delivering exceptional care when it matters most. As a leading accident assistance and aftercare provider, we support customers involved in non-fault accidents by supplying replacement vehicles and managing their claims with empathy and efficiency.

Our values Inspired to Innovate, Always Respectful, Fully Accountable, and Delivering Delight are at the heart of everything we do. About the role

We are looking for a Customer Support Advisor to efficiently and effectively manage a case load of motor claims during the period in which customers are utilising our hire vehicles. You will be required to attend the Fort Dunlop office for a minimum of two days per week.

What you'll be doing
- manage the hire process including quality checking claims to ensure no delays have occurred which would/or could affect the recovering of our hire charges
- accurately assess claim status and documentation on receipt of assigned claims to ensure claims are managed in the most efficient manner
- correctly validate claim type (whether credit repair, third party or Policyholder Insurer) to ensure repair work is authorised appropriately
- verify all relevant and correct documentation is received to correct standard and recorded on the claim
- effectively monitor the timely processing of assigned motor claims to deliver agreed targets, customer expectations and business objectives
- liaise with external partners including Third Party Insurers, Policyholder Insurers, Solicitors, Referrers and Repairers with a view to progressing and actively managing the claim and positively influencing those involved
- maintain effective contact with the customer keeping them updated and dealing with any issues or problems that may arise during the hire period
- ensure all costs associated to the hire period can be billed and recovered through efficient claims management or accurate notification of justifiable delays.

What you'll bring
- demonstrable experience within a fast-paced customer service role, ideally phone-based customer service environment preferred
- clear verbal communication skills, demonstrating persuasive and assertive behaviour
- competent using MS Office
- ability to prioritise, recognising importance and urgency
- good written communication skills
- ability to work under pressure with a flexible attitude and approach, on own initiative
- demonstrate commercial awareness
- demonstrate behaviours in line with Company values; Inspired to Innovate, Always Respectful, Fully Accountable, Delivering Delight.

What we offer
- Up to £28,300 OTE
- 22 days holiday (plus bank holidays), rising to 27 with service
- Workplace pension scheme
- Bupa Private Healthcare (optional)
- Life Assurance (4x salary)
- Employee Assistance Programme and wellbeing tools
- Retail discounts and savings
- Ongoing professional development and career growth opportunities
- One charity/volunteering day off per year.

Wellbeing, diversity and inclusion

For the third year in a row, we are proud to share that we've won an Inspiring Workplace Award. This is testament to our commitment to fostering a positive and inclusive workplace where every individual feels valued, supported, and empowered and remain focused on creating a culture where everyone can thrive and feel genuinely appreciated.

We've also achieved Thrive at Work Bronze Level accreditation from the West Midlands Combined Authority, recognising our commitment to improving health and wellbeing in our workplace.

If our values resonate with you and you're excited about this opportunity, we'd love to hear from you. You might be just who we're looking for.

title: Receptionist
description: An exciting opportunity has arisen for an experienced Receptionist with a passion for delivering exceptional customer service. Tanworth in Arden Medical Practice, South Warwickshire is seeking an experienced and dedicated individual to join our friendly and supportive Practice Team making a positive impact on the service delivered to our local community. The successful candidate will ideally work 22-26 hours per week; Mondays and Wednesdays would be essential. Key Responsibilities: Ensure the smooth operation of our reception desk with professionalism and organisation. Answering calls, reviewing emails, inbound documents and prescription requests. Act as the primary point of contact, ensuring clear communication between patients, clinicians, and our practice team. Helping signpost patients to services. Deliver consistently high standards of customer service at all times. We value individuals who are organised, adaptable, and personable - committed to delivering excellent customer service. Key attributes we are looking for include: Previous experience in medical/healthcare reception roles. Excellent communication skills with a clear and polite telephone manner. Ability to maintain confidentiality and discretion regarding patient information. Experience in handling sensitive situations with empathy and professionalism. Strong teamwork and independent problem-solving abilities. Proficient in IT and general administration tasks. Job responsibilities The Role: To ensure the smooth running of the reception desk in a professional and organised manner. To be the focal point of the surgery and to act as a liaison between patients, clinicians and other members of your practice team and to provide a high standard of customer services at all times. Some flexibility is required to accommodate additional or alternative hours to cover colleagues during annual/sickness leave. Duties: 1. Greet all patients on arrival ensuring all patients are checked in either manually or via the patient touch screen 2. To answer the telephone dealing with or redirecting enquiries. 3. To handle all face to face general enquiries, referring where necessary. 4. Make new and follow-up appointments including booking interpreters when needed. 5. To be responsible for the call and recall of patient lists as instructed by the Practice Manager including the recall for immunisation/smear targets and test recalls. 6. Responsible for dealing with messages from patients/clinicians or external bodies. To take appropriate action where required. 7. Generate electronic/online repeat prescription requests and allocate as instructed. Prepare repeat prescriptions following practice protocol and set out for verification and signature of doctor. 8. Record requests for home visits and ensure that they are recorded and passed onto relevant clinician. 9. Register new patients following practice policy including enabling secure online access to patients medical records and booking patients for new registration health checks. 10. Open mail and distribute as appropriate. Leave private, confidential and personal mail unopened in Practice Managers tray as directed.. 11. Maintain computer databases including the patients PDS records. 12. Ensure that the External and Internal email accounts are viewed on a daily basis and the Workflow tasks are completed appropriately. Log outgoing post/mail as necessary and take responsibility of posting at the end of the day. 13. Take responsibility of the daily incoming electronic document management & the online PATCHS consultation forms 14. Offer all services to patients including, extended opening hours & Community Pharmacy Consultation Services (CPCS) and any future new initiatives. 15. Enter appropriate read codes as instructed by practice. 16. Ensure that there is enough supply of stationary/equipment in all consulting rooms. 17. Ensure that all clinic attendance appointments are confirmed prior to appointment date as per allocation of tasks. 18. Leave reception area tidy and ready for incoming colleagues. Use the EMIS Web as instructed to communicate any outstanding queries to colleagues. 19. Staff working in the evening, to make sure that the premises are fully vacated by patients . Ensuring that the premises are securely locked. 20. Undertake any other duties as instructed by management. This job description may need to be reviewed or revised from time to time as the practice develops. Confidentiality The post holder will: Maintain strict confidentiality regarding all patient, staff and practice information. Comply with GDPR, NHS confidentiality requirements and practice policies. Only disclose confidential information to authorised individuals in accordance with practice procedures. Health and Safety The successful candidate will: Follow all practice Health & Safety and Infection Prevention and Control policies. Maintain a safe, clean and tidy working environment. Report hazards, incidents and risks promptly. Attend mandatory training, including annual infection control training. Support safeguarding responsibilities for children and vulnerable adults. Equality, Diversity and Inclusion Treat all patients, carers and colleagues with dignity, respect and compassion. Promote equality and diversity in accordance with current legislation and practice policies. Provide a welcoming, inclusive and non-judgemental service to everyone. Personal and Professional Development Participate in annual appraisals and performance reviews. Undertake mandatory and role-specific training. Take responsibility for their own learning and professional development. Quality Maintain high standards of patient care and customer service. Work collaboratively with the wider practice team. Manage their workload effectively and contribute to service improvements. Report quality or safety concerns appropriately. Communication Communicate professionally and effectively with patients, colleagues and external organisations. Recognise and respond to patients' individual communication needs. Work as a supportive and valued member of the practice team.
